title: CFTC Commitments of Traders signals (futures book and CME bitcoin -> crypto books)
registered: 2026-10-19, before the COT data was downloaded (get_free_data2.bat)
data: research_data/more2/cot_disagg.parquet and cot_tff.parquet (futures-only). Report date = Tuesday; released Friday 15:30 ET; a signal is used from the next Monday 00:00 UTC (no earlier). Contracts matched to Databento roots by CFTC market code/name (mapping fixed in code before results)

tests.C1 managed money extremes, commodities (: disagg: (M_Money long - short) / open interest; z vs trailing 156 weeks; z > 1.5 -> short, z < -1.5 -> long; equal risk; held one week; GC SI HG CL NG RB HO ZC ZS ZW LE HE
tests.C2 leveraged funds extremes, financials: TFF: (Lev_Money long - short) / open interest, same z rule; ES NQ ZN ZB 6E 6J 6B 6A
tests.C3 hedging pressure (Basu-Miffre): disagg producer/merchant net short / their total position; monthly: long the 4 commodities with the highest hedging pressure, short the 4 lowest; equal risk
tests.C4 CME bitcoin leveraged funds (contrari: TFF bitcoin contract: leveraged funds net / OI, z vs 52 weeks; z > 1.5 -> short BTC 0.5, z < -1.5 -> long 0.5 for the week; Binance perp / BrightFunded costs; crypto book rule

rules: C1-C3: futures stand-alone rule of Gen114 (DEV 2010-17 > 0, TEST 2018-22 >= 0.5, HOLD 2023-26 >= 0.3, net of Databento-based costs). C4: standard crypto rule into v6 and bf
